```{r}
setwd("../data")
source('../R/nba_functions_database.R', chdir = TRUE)
year <- 2019

files <- c(
  "Bam_Adebayo_2018_2024.csv",
  "Stephen_Curry_2015_2022.csv",
  "Klay_Thompson_2015_2024.csv",
  "Draymond_Green_2015_2024.csv",
  "Kyle_Korver_2014_2020.csv",
  "James_Harden_2015_2024.csv",
  "Evan_Fournier_2015_2024.csv",
  "Anthony_Davis_2015_2025.csv",
  #"Nic_Claxton_2020_2025.csv",
  "Jarrett_Allen_2018_2024.csv",
  "Alex_Caruso_2018_2024.csv",
  "Kevin_Durant_2015_2024.csv",
  "LeBron_James_2015_2024.csv",
  "Joel_Embiid_2017_2022.csv"
  
)
setwd("../data")
shots_by_player <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    nba_data_csv(f, year)
})
shots_made_by_player <- lapply(shots_by_player, function(df) {
  df[df$SHOT_MADE == TRUE, ]
})
data_by_player <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  nba_data_depth(
    nba_data_csv(f, year)
  )
})
names(data_by_player) <- gsub("_\\d{4}_\\d{4}\\.csv$", "", files)
names(data_by_player) <- gsub("_", " ", names(data_by_player))
names(shots_by_player) <- gsub("_\\d{4}_\\d{4}\\.csv$", "", files)
names(shots_by_player) <- gsub("_", " ", names(data_by_player))
```

```{r}

library(MASS)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1. GLOBAL NORMALIZATION TO [0,1]^2
# ---------------------------------------------------
all_x <- unlist(lapply(shots_made_by_player, function(df) df$LOC_X))
all_y <- unlist(lapply(shots_made_by_player, function(df) df$LOC_Y))

xmin <- min(all_x)
xmax <- max(all_x)

ymin <- min(all_y)
ymax <- max(all_y)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2. TRANSFORM TO s* = logit-normalized COORDINATES
# ---------------------------------------------------
process_transform <- function(df){

  x <- (df$LOC_X - xmin) / (xmax - xmin)
  y <- (df$LOC_Y - ymin) / (ymax - ymin)

  eps <- 1e-6
  x <- pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)
  y <- pmin(pmax(y, eps), 1 - eps)

  cbind(
    qlogis(x),
    qlogis(y)
  )
}

proc_list <- lapply(shots_by_player, process_transform)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3. GAUSSIAN KERNEL SUM (NO GRID)
# ---------------------------------------------------
kernel_sum <- function(X, Y = X, c2 = 1){

  X <- as.matrix(X)
  Y <- as.matrix(Y)

  nx <- rowSums(X^2)
  ny <- rowSums(Y^2)

  D2 <- outer(nx, ny, "+") - 2 * X %*% t(Y)

  sum(exp(-(c2^2 / 2) * D2))
}


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 4. PAPER DISTANCE d_F(s,t)
# ---------------------------------------------------
smooth_distance <- function(S, T, c1 = 1, c2 = 1){

  A <- kernel_sum(S, S, c2)   # first sum
  B <- kernel_sum(T, T, c2)   # second sum
  C <- kernel_sum(S, T, c2)   # cross sum

  const <- c1^2 * pi / (2 * c2^2)

  sqrt(max(const * (A + B - 2 * C), 0))
}


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5. DISTANCE MATRIX
# ---------------------------------------------------
n <- length(proc_list)

D <- matrix(0, n, n)

for(i in 1:n){
  for(j in i:n){

    dij <- smooth_distance(
      proc_list[[i]],
      proc_list[[j]],
      c1 = 1,
      c2 = 1
    )

    D[i, j] <- dij
    D[j, i] <- dij
  }
}

rownames(D) <- names(shots_by_player)
colnames(D) <- names(shots_by_player)

D
heatmap(D)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6. ISO-MDS VISUALIZATION
# ---------------------------------------------------
mds_iso <- isoMDS(D, k = 2)

plot(mds_iso$points,
     asp = 1,
     pch = 19,
     xlab = "Dim 1",
     ylab = "Dim 2",
     main = "NBA Players - Smoothing Distance (Paper Method)")

text(mds_iso$points,
     labels = rownames(D),
     pos = 3,
     cex = 0.8)
```
